title: Read Inside the Lifetime

tests.name: defined read
tests.hint: p = &local; return *p; — the read happens before the block ends, so it is perfectly defined.

tests.name: matches the probe
tests.hint: The defined path must observe exactly g_probe — the same value leak_local *would* have dangled with.

tests.name: repeatable
tests.hint: A lifetime-correct read is stable; UB is the thing that comes and goes.
